assertions.name: n4_markov_normalisation_is_one
assertions.source: Sum_lambda f^lambda y_lambda = 1 exact symbolic in z

description: bean qou-3quc: the Jones-Markov weights y_lambda ARE the Webster-Williamson S_n Molien series -- general n. y_lambda = M_nu(u=q^2, t=qz/(q^2-qz-1)) * (1+qz-q^2)^(n-1). Verified exact at n=3 (companion probe/Lean) and at n=4: Sum f^lam y_lam = 1 exact symbolic; at z=z_D the >=3-row weights vanish (two-row cap) and survivors reproduce the corpus SU(2) q-dims. Normaliser is a power of ONE linear form (Poincare/Molien shape), not [n]_q!. Nothing wired.
q0AnchorReason: q0-independent: EXACT SYMBOLIC in q and z (sp.symbols), as this file's own docstring states. q_0 is reachable through the Hecke machinery it imports but is never evaluated at -- nothing substitutes a pin, and no q_0 value reaches the payload.
